short_description: White wireless earbuds with stem design are the go-to budget TWS earphones for calls, online classes, and everyday music. They deliver clear vocals and punchy bass for reels, YouTube, and playlists, while the in‑ear fit helps reduce outside noise naturally...
description:
White wireless earbuds with stem design are the go-to budget TWS earphones for calls, online classes, and everyday music. They deliver clear vocals and punchy bass for reels, YouTube, and playlists, while the in‑ear fit helps reduce outside noise naturally for a more focused listen. Pair quickly over Bluetooth with Android or iPhone and enjoy a stable connection for videos and daily commuting.

Use touch controls to play/pause, manage calls, and control listening without reaching for your phone. Each earbud gives up to 4 hours playback per charge, and the compact charging case extends total backup to about 12–15 hours—perfect for a full day of travel, office use, or study sessions. Pocket-friendly and simple to use, these stem-style earbuds bring a clean look and reliable performance at an easy price.

features: Modern white stem-style design: Clean, familiar look that sits comfortably for daily commuting, office wear, and casual use.
Clear vocals + punchy bass tuning: Good balance for calls, podcasts, YouTube and music without sounding thin.
Touch controls on earbuds: Play/pause, answer/end calls and basic controls without pulling out your phone.
Built-in microphone for calls and meetings: Designed for everyday calling and online classes in normal indoor/outdoor environments.
Up to 4 hours playback per charge: Suitable for long calls or a workout session before needing a quick top-up.
12–15 hours total backup with case: Charging case extends use through the day for travel, study and office shifts.
Compact, pocket-friendly charging case: Easy to carry in jeans or small bags for on-the-go charging.
Android + iPhone compatible: Works with most Bluetooth devices including phones, tablets and laptops.
